units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside near the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, a faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse under dusk. Locked-off low close-up on bare asphalt. Two pairs of feet alone, four shoes and only four shoes in the whole frame; the rest of the road stays bare grey asphalt. Four shoes travel forward along the faded white line, dust lifting at each contact, white paint bright underfoot. The camera and the background never move: the ground, the fields and the farmhouse stay exactly as they are from the first frame to the last. 35mm film grain, warm dusk telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 2001 Taiwan music video look
